## Position Overview
We are looking for a skilled and detail-oriented ICT Support and Test Engineer to join our team and play a key role in maintaining the integrity, performance, and quality of our systems and infrastructure. This role combines technical support, quality assurance, and systems testing to ensure seamless operations and adherence to established standards. The ideal candidate brings a methodical approach to problem-solving, strong communication skills, and a solid foundation in ICT systems and environments. This position suits an experienced professional who thrives in a collaborative setting and is committed to delivering high-quality technical outcomes.
## Key Responsibilities
- Schedule and conduct quality audit inspections across systems, data, and documentation, identifying variations and potential high-risk areas to ensure continued adherence to established standards and procedures.
- Investigate, diagnose, and resolve system problems and performance issues, providing hands-on troubleshooting support for desktops, hardware, software, printers, databases, operating systems, email platforms, and network connectivity.
- Test the functionality, behaviour, and integrity of systems and application code within defined testing protocols and quality frameworks, identifying and documenting errors, faults, and deviations from specification.
- Develop, implement, and maintain quality assurance processes, guidelines, and strategies to support system reliability, security, and performance across the organisation.
- Recommend and facilitate corrective action plans to address non-compliance issues identified through ongoing monitoring, auditing, and review of operational processes and procedures.
- Perform organisational systems architecture reviews and assessments, providing well-informed recommendations on current and future hardware and software strategies aligned with business needs.
- Develop and deliver technical guidance, training, and support to end users and stakeholders on application software, operational procedures, and best practice usage.
- Communicate and liaise effectively with users and management to promote awareness of quality control standards, data integrity requirements, and ICT compliance obligations.
- Create, review, and maintain comprehensive technical documentation including procedural guides, operational manuals, technical specifications, testing reports, and maintenance inventory records.
- Assist in the planning and execution of system upgrades, installations, configurations, and patch management activities to minimise disruption and maintain system availability.
- Monitor and evaluate system infrastructure to proactively identify risks and opportunities for improvement, contributing to the ongoing optimisation of ICT environments.
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams and project stakeholders to support the delivery of ICT initiatives and ensure quality outcomes are achieved throughout the project lifecycle.
## Required Qualifications & Skills
- A bachelor's degree or diploma in Information Technology, Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related discipline; or equivalent demonstrated experience in a similar ICT role.
- Proven experience in ICT technical support, systems testing, or quality assurance within a professional environment.
- Strong understanding of testing methodologies, quality assurance frameworks, and audit processes across systems and software.
- Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues across a broad range of ICT systems, including hardware, software, operating systems, and network components.
- Experience developing and maintaining technical documentation such as test plans, procedural guides, specifications, and operational manuals.
- Solid knowledge of database management, system security, backup procedures, and infrastructure performance monitoring.
- Proficiency in diagnosing software and hardware faults and delivering appropriate solutions within agreed timeframes and service levels.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a structured, methodical approach to quality assurance and issue resolution.
- Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to convey technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
- Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a team, managing competing priorities and deadlines effectively.
## Preferred Qualifications
- Relevant industry certifications such as ITIL Foundation, CompTIA A+, CompTIA Network+, ISTQB (Software Testing), or Microsoft Certified qualifications.
- Experience with enterprise-level systems, cloud platforms, or virtualisation technologies such as AWS, Azure, or VMware.
- Familiarity with IT service management (ITSM) tools such as ServiceNow, Jira, or Zendesk.
- Exposure to Agile or DevOps delivery environments and associated testing practices such as continuous integration and automated testing.
- Previous experience conducting formal ICT audits, architecture reviews, or compliance assessments.
- Knowledge of relevant Australian and international ICT standards and frameworks, including ISO/IEC 27001 or COBIT.
## Why Join Us?
- Be part of a collaborative, forward-thinking team that values innovation, continuous improvement, and professional growth.
- Access ongoing learning and development opportunities, including support for professional certifications and industry training.
- Enjoy a flexible work environment with options for hybrid working arrangements to support work-life balance.
- Contribute to meaningful, large-scale ICT projects that have a real impact on organisational performance and service delivery.
- Competitive salary package with opportunities for career progression within a growing and dynamic technology function.

Nautilus Aviation (as part of Morris Aviation) is a proven helicopter specialist with over 25 years flying experience and has grown to become one of Australia’s premier helicopter operators. Today our network of bases spans Cairns, Port Douglas, Townsville, Darwin, Jabiru, Gove and Torres Strait (Horn Island).

Nautilus Aviation has recently expanded its operations into southern Australia with the acquisition of Heli Surveys (including Snowy Mountains Helicopters), based in Jindabyne NSW in the heart of the Snowy Mountains.

We are now seeking a Senior Base Engineer to lead the maintenance operations at the Heli Surveys home base in Jindabyne.

This is an outstanding opportunity for a suitably qualified Licensed Aircraft Maintenance Engineer (LAME) with extensive helicopter experience who is looking for a rewarding career combined with an exceptional outdoor lifestyle.

We have a full-time position available for a highly experienced LAME. There is a variety of roster types and flexibility available for negotiation. As part of the role, you may be required to undertake short duration trips to alternate bases in support of our dynamic and varied fleet (including the Heli Surveys remote bases in Lakes Entrance, Victoria and Victor Harbor, South Australia).

As the Senior Base Engineer (LAME) for Heli Surveys as part of Nautilus Aviation, you will be responsible for ensuring aircraft are maintained to the highest standards of safety and airworthiness while working closely with our Chief Engineer and Head of Airworthiness & Maintenance Control (HAAMC), based in North Queensland.

The Senior Base Engineer (LAME) will be charged with:

-  Overseeing all maintenance and servicing on the fleet of AS350/H125, Bell 407, Bell 212 and Bell 412 helicopters
-  Certifying for line and heavy maintenance on the fleet of AS350/H125, Bell 407, Bell 212 and Bell 412 helicopters both at home base and in remote locations when required
-  Certifying for defect rectifications / rectifying breakdowns on our AS350/H125, Bell 407, Bell 212 and Bell 412 fleet both at home base and at remote locations as required
-  Leading and supervising all other LAME's, AME's and Apprentices on a day to day basis in carrying out maintenance on company aircraft
-  Ensuring all aircraft maintenance is certified and complied with in accordance with company procedures
-  Communicating with the company Chief Engineer and Head of Airworthiness & Maintenance Control (HAAMC) and operations to ensure all stakeholders are informed of current status of all aircraft

-  Relocation assistance to the right candidate
-  Competitive remuneration package
-  Opportunity to work across a diverse fleet of helicopters
-  Work on a varied range of rotary wing aircraft
-  Staff discounts on helicopter charters and training
-  Winter ski season pass
-  Summer mountain biking season pass
-  Exclusive employee discounts across the Morris Group's hospitality, tourism and leisure businesses
-  Career development opportunities across Heli Surveys, Nautilus Aviation and the wider Morris Group

-  The right to live and work in Australia (visa sponsorship may be considered for the right candidate)
-  Valid Australian Driver’s license
-  CASA-recognised Aircraft Maintenance Engineer qualifications
-  CASA recognised qualifications/licence : B412 and/or B212
-  Experience maintaining AS350/H125 helicopters
-  Experience maintaining Bell helicopters
-  Leadership and management skills
-  Ability to lead a team of LAME's, AME's, Apprentices and other staff
-  Excellent verbal and written communication skills
-  Computer literacy with experience on aircraft computer aided maintenance systems
-  Strong organisational skills
-  The ability to prioritise workloads and manage competing demands
-  The ability to work both independently and as part of a team
-  A proactive, self-motivated approach
-  A strong commitment to a safe work environment and legal/regulatory compliance
-  Positive and professional attitude
-  Current ASIC and Human Factors qualifications (or ability to obtain/renew with company assistance)

-  Preference will be given to candidates with experience in AS350/H125, Bell 407, Bell 212/412 and Robinson R44 helicopters

With more than 25 years of operational experience, Heli Surveys has established itself as one of Australia's leading utility helicopter operators. As part of the Morris Group and sister company to Nautilus Aviation, we operate from a network of bases including Cairns, Port Douglas, Townsville, Darwin, Jabiru, Gove, Horn Island and Jindabyne.

Our fleet supports a wide variety of utility operations throughout Australia, providing our engineers with diverse and interesting work in a dynamic environment.

Nautilus Aviation has built an outstanding reputation based on the quality and diversity of our fleet of helicopters and our commitment to the safety of all passengers and personnel at all times.

We pride ourselves on our customer service from the delivery of commercial air work, pilot training, Search & Rescue and chartered flights all while working in partnership with a number of top tourism operators to deliver leisure experiences over some of the iconic natural landscapes of Australia.

Nautilus Aviation and Heli Surveys are part of the Morris Group of companies. Morris Group is an independent, family-run business that was founded in 1980 and operates a collection of iconic Australian experiences. With businesses in tourism, hospitality, aviation, and technology, we’re on a mission to make a positive impact doing work we love. From luxury resorts and lodges to urban beer gardens, elevated dining experiences, and super-yacht adventures; everything we do is inspired by our love for good company and the great outdoors.

In addition to Nautilus Aviation, Morris Group also owns and operates a collection of hotels and luxury lodges in Queensland as part of Morris Escapes – including Beechmont Estate, Orpheus Island Lodge, Pelorus Island and Mt Mulligan Lodge. Morris Group is also the owner of the world-class holiday destinations The Ville Resort-Casino and Ardo Hotel, both located in Townsville QLD.

Morris Group also includes Morris Hospitality that focuses on creating elevated dining experiences with venues including the Albert Park Hotel, Portsea Hotel, Railway Club Hotel, O’Connell’s, Half Moon and the Lucky Coq in Victoria, the Julatten Hotel in Queensland and CBCo Brewing in Victoria and Western Australia.
